name: client-ledger
description: Bill clients for Claude Code work: per-client time, tokens and proof of work, exported as invoice-ready logs

hourlyRate.title: Hourly rate
hourlyRate.description: What you bill per hour of tracked time (0 = don't price hours)

tokenRatePerMillion.title: Token rate per million
tokenRatePerMillion.description: What you bill per million tokens, on top of hours (0 = don't bill tokens)

idleMinutes.title: Idle cap (minutes)
idleMinutes.description: Gaps between your prompts longer than this count only this long as your own work time

exportDir.title: Export folder
exportDir.description: Where /ledger export writes files (empty = ledger-exports in the current folder)
